envelope.author: nico
envelope.cause: assay of supported harness on what-ships

spec.name: event-tap-degrades-on-omp
spec.intent: event-tap ships to omp but the runtime has only a Claude strategy: from an omp context 'cratylus eventTap install' writes <cwd>/.claude/settings.json and 'status' reports attached: true while omp never reads that file (loci: packages/runtime/src/capabilities/event-tap/dispatch.ts:148-153; packages/forge/src/project/index.ts:679-684). Degrade and warn per the fidelity ladder: (1) projecting event-tap to a harness whose runtime has no tap strategy warns once at projection and install, naming the capability, the harness and what is lost (the skill still ships as a declaration, never silently); (2) the runtime determines which harness invoked it (from the host runtime config or the invoking environment; choose what is reliable and say why) and, when that harness has no tap strategy, refuses install with a message naming the harness and that only Claude Code has a tap today, writing nothing; (3) status never reports attached for a harness it did not attach to. Claude behaviour unchanged.
accept: projecting the corpus with --harness omp prints exactly one warning naming event-tap and omp; --harness claude prints none
in a temp dir with an omp invocation context, cratylus eventTap install exits non-zero, names omp and Claude Code, and creates no .claude directory
status in that context never reports attached: true
claude eventTap install/status tests unchanged and green
runtime and forge targeted tests, typecheck and biome on outputs pass
